---
name: css
description: Make focused, responsive, accessible CSS changes while preserving existing styles and plugin integrations.
---

# CSS skill

1. Inspect the target stylesheet and related markup before changing styles.
2. Follow existing selectors, naming, formatting, and responsive breakpoints.
3. Keep selectors scoped to the intended component; avoid unnecessary overrides and `!important`.
4. Check whether a framework or plugin supplies the relevant styles. Prefer a local, scoped override and do not edit vendor styles.
5. Check responsive behavior and accessibility, including focus and reduced-motion behavior where relevant.
6. Run available style checks or verify the affected page in a browser when possible.
